answer.reason: For 2024 Q4, Nevada's construction sector had grown to roughly the 105,000–110,000 job range after several years of post-pandemic expansion, making a December 2024 private-sector covered employment level of about 109,190 for NAICS 23 consistent with known magnitudes. The alternative figure of 74,302 corresponds to Nevada construction employment levels of a much earlier period (mid-2010s), not 2024, so option B is implausible for this reference period.

A. 109,190 covered jobs
B. 74,302 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Nevada statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/32000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: A
